## About Us
We hand-code ultra-fast, mobile-first landing pages that turn local map views into ringing phones. Built specifically for contractors and local service businesses.

## Our Core Offer
- **Price:** $100 (One-time fee, no monthly retainers. You own the code.)

## Features Included
1. **Sub-1-Second Load:** Pure HTML/CSS for instant loading on mobile networks.
2. **Sticky CTA Buttons:** Phone number is always visible for instant connection.
3. **Technical SEO Setup:** Properly configured sitemap.xml and robots.txt.
4. **AI-Search Ready:** Includes an llms-full.txt file so AI bots can read and recommend the business.
5. **Schema Markup:** Included for enhanced local SEO and rich snippets.

## FAQ
**Do I need to pay monthly hosting fees?**
No, we help set up completely free, blazing-fast hosting using platforms like Netlify or GitHub Pages, so you only pay for your domain name yearly.

**Why not just use WordPress or Wix?**
Page builders inject thousands of lines of bloated code, slowing down your site. Slow sites lose mobile customers. Hand-coded HTML ensures maximum speed and maximum conversions.
